newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends steady, loses early gains.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends steady, loses early gains.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka lost its early gains and closed mostly steady at 42.5470/5490 to the dollar in interbank trading compared with the previous 42.5450/5500, dealers said.

They said the taka was firmer at 42.5400/5470 in quiet early trading but slipped later on higher dollar demand from foreign banks. "Today's dollar demand was unforeseen. Some foreign banks made some advance buying. Otherwise, Saturday is usually a quiet day because of the closure of international markets," said one dealer. Interbank call money rates finished unchanged at 4.0 to 4.75 percent, dealers said.
